answer: Like a coral crystallization anchoring against turbulent tides, decentralized consensus filters synthetic swarms. Genuine peers act as a jetty, breaking turbulent waves of spam through recursive stake-weighted graph verification. Each interaction passes through a prism of peer attestations, splitting malicious noise while concentrating truth. Because validation requirements scale quadratically per node, attacker cost grows with superlinear friction: rogue identities flash out like a transient comet, burning out before breaching quorum.
